title: Drone flights over Nevada nuclear testing range
place_text: Nevada nuclear testing range, north of Las Vegas

tellings.quote: earlier there were several mystery drone flights over our nuclear testing range in Nevada just north of Las Vegas

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2024 there were several mystery drone flights over the US nuclear testing range in Nevada, just north of Las Vegas. He tells it as part of a wider point that unknown objects seem to watch nuclear sites, which, if true, would mean someone is keeping an eye on the country's most sensitive weapons ground.
